About Filecoin

Filecoin is a decentralized storage network where providers earn FIL for storing data and proving they still hold it.

Where this FIL price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (FIL-USD), Binance (FIL/USDT) and Kraken (FIL/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 690,197,000 FIL (supply last updated October 30, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
